DECLARE @Datetoprocess DATE
SET @Datetoprocess = '2024-01-08'

DELETE FROM EDS.TRU_AUMNONUITF WHERE AS_OF_DATE = @Datetoprocess;

INSERT INTO EDS.TRU_AUMNONUITF
(
    AS_OF_DATE
,   BASE_NO
,   LAST6_BASE_NO
,   PF_NO
,   LAST6_PF_NO
,   PRODUCT_CODE
,   AUM
,   AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR
,   ASOFDATE
,	BNK_CODE
,	SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
@Datetoprocess AS AS_OF_DATE
,   BASE_NO
,   LAST6_BASE_NO
,   PF_NO
,   LAST6_PF_NO
,   PRODUCT_CODE
,   AUM
,   AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR
,   ASOFDATE
,	left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
,	substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_TRU_AUMNONUITF
WHERE H = 'D'
